name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
summary: A nonpartisan think tank in Washington that researches policy on advanced AI and national security (frontier security and AI-enabled cyber attacks, compute policy such as export controls and chip location verification, US-China strategy), briefs policymakers and runs a three-month AI Policy Fellowship. It began in 2023 as Rethink Priorities' AI governance department, was fiscally sponsored by Rethink Priorities through 2025, and in 2026 became its own US charity (EIN 32-0839313) with an independent board.

IAPS has filed no return of its own yet. Rethink Priorities' record and models leave this line out of its spending, so it is counted once, here.)
